The two End-only changes do trigger their captured native Logs reads. Same-minute/wider reads include the actual synthetic records; this does not establish exact subsecond sampling or record-loss semantics.

HTTP_REQUESTS succeeds at resolution1 and the separate monthly total succeeds with reported degraded sources. The visible chart alert was initially misidentified as a monthly footer failure and corrected from actual requests/source; no new issue is claimed.

Chip controls are native exact discovered-instance application/error reads at fresh390/360 and desktop. Mouse removal at390 and Enter at360 preserve Level; short Level removal preserves Instance. Titles/full DOM text and horizontal geometry are retained; native tooltip display and physical touch gestures were not tested.

Deploy-detail instance filtering is client-local; the URL stays unchanged. Desktop/390/360 shared-chip geometry is real. Mobile deployment measurements were below the fold before normal keyboard focus scrolling; only horizontal containment is claimed, not initial intersection with the vertical viewport. Static deploy-detail route, other log types and long path values were not reaccepted.

No style/ARIA injection or new old-source counterfactual in this sweep. Original failing geometry, implementation checks and regressions remain historical. No source/test changes or suite rerun for this acceptance-only filing.

Wrong service Log type role and Application option label were corrected before dependent actions. One navigation observer deferred a response body until after navigation; its protocol/body error is excluded and the fresh native read was recaptured while consuming the body at response time. No write was replayed and no browser restarted.

Transport abort2302 is a DeployActions query; connection closure2925 is a ViewerCapabilities query. Later independent/native reads and cleanup pass. Snapshot contains native browser traffic; explicit APIRequestContext probes have their complete separate receipts.

Only the complete relevant native operation body is retained when the original HTTP batch contained several operations with the same name. Selected index and batch length disambiguate HTTP_REQUESTS from other Metrics operations.
